why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the rewards site and connect a wallet Go to the dTelecom rewards site and connect a wallet so your points and rewards history are tracked.
2 Step 2 : Read the Points Program rules The Points Program page lists the stages, the apps that award points and the conversion options at the token launch.
3 Step 3 : Use dMeet and the other dTelecom apps Host or join meetings on dMeet, or use Livestreaming, AI Voice Agent and Spatial, to earn points for activity.
4 Step 4 : Complete tasks and invite friends Finish the tasks on offer, report bugs you find and invite other people to the apps, all of which the program rewards with points.
5 Step 5 : Check your points history Return to the rewards site with your wallet connected to see the points and rewards you have earned.
